sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Gunsmith Master - Part 3 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "I've said too much last time. It happens when I'm alone with my thoughts for a while. A lot of stuff comes to mind while I sit here calibrating the sights. That M4 turned out splendid, got taken off my hands in a moment. A BEAR dropped by recently, goes by the name of Sniper or something. He needs a Lobaev DVL sniper rifle, with a scope and multi-laser device. With recoil sum less than 450, ergonomics above 36, and weight below 6.7 kg. He said it needs to be a 2000m shot. The guy is serious, so do your best to make a solid build."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - Must be level 30 to start this quest.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Modify a DVL-10 to comply with the given specifications

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +20,400 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.03
- 200,000 Roubles
  - 210,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 230,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 2× Pack of screws
- 1× Electric drill
- 1× Metal fuel tank
- Unlocks purchase of Lone Star TX-15 DML 5.56x45 carbine at Skier LL3
"Thank you, leave the rifle on the table, I'll hand it over to Di— ahem, Sniper."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
DVL-10 specifications:
- 60 Durability
- 36 or greater ergonomics
- 450 or less recoil
- 2,000 or greater sighting range
- 6.7 kg or less in weight
- Any tactical device (such as the NcSTAR Tactical Blue Laser)

sections.heading: Build
sections.text: This is one example of many possible configurations.

sections.heading: Notes:
sections.text:
- This build is based on a standard DVL-10 from Skier LL3.
- Besides the scope listed below, you can also use the Schmidt & Bender PM II 5-25x56 34mm riflescope which can be bought at Jaeger LL3. Note that it is not compatible with the IEA Mil-Optics KH/F 34mm one-piece magmount.
- The quest check mark is not consistent even when all requirements are met, it not being present doesn't mean the gun can't be handed over.
